item.title: 14 Turkey Farm Promotional Posters Sabotaged (Midlands, UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: A simple task, perhaps not as courageous as others but a task nonetheless. Committed alone that you can try at home! In the dead of night I was driving through a village and noticed brand new “Christmas turkey sold here” signs from a local farm. They’d just been put up that day and … Continue reading

item.title: Cow Trucks Sabotaged (Netherlands)
item.description: Received anonymously: In the early morning on the 14h of December in the Netherlands we visited a logistics hub used to transport cows. There are 55 locations in the country with a license to transport animals this way. These hubs are the small points of failure that allow all other abuse in the industry to … Continue reading

item.title: 2 Fur Farms Visited, Sabotaged; One Empty, One Abandoned (USA)
item.description: Received anonymously: On November 15th I visited two fur farms. At the first I spent 20 minutes or so taking down a few hundred feet of fencing before heading in to get to the prisoners. I noticed it was suspiciously quiet and soon, to my delight, discovered that the farm had been completely shut down, … Continue reading

item.title: ALF Liberates 6 Hens (Germany)
item.description: Received anonymously: Unfortunately, with this text we have to do exactly what we do not want to do – place humans at the center. Yet, for once, this is necessary in order to clear away a misguided line of thought. We are not heroes! Animal liberation is not an act of greatness. Not a triumph. … Continue reading

item.title: 18 Turkeys Liberated, Avoid Christmas Slaughter (UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: As the nation gets ready to celebrate a bloodbath, 18 precious turkeys were saved from a factory farm. This action took place many weeks ago, ensuring the turkeys were still small and weren’t impacted by the fattening food given to them at farms. For their safety, we waited to announce their liberation. If … Continue reading

item.title: Banners Dropped Protesting Treatment of Cows (Netherlands)
item.description: Received anonymously: On Saturday, December 13th, people hung banners above the highway. The banners were hung at highway exits leading to cattle collection points where the research group Ongehoord recently filmed footage. These images show that (milked-out) cows and calves are systematically exploited and abused. The violent behavior of these cattle traders is not an … Continue reading

item.title: 2 Doves Liberated from Fur and Feather Auction (UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: Last September in the north of the UK we heard of a fur and feather auction happening in a dirty little pub. In fur and feather auctions, backyard breeders with zero regulations auction ‘pet’ animals to the highest bidder, or sell them in their stalls. It truly is a grim environment, with animals … Continue reading

item.title: Breeding Guinea Pigs Liberated (Midlands, UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: After having learnt about fur and feather auctions we have been busy working out where the scummy breeders live. We followed a rabbit and guinea pig breeder back to their house, and once we found a suitable home we paid them a visit during Halloween. item.title: 3 Gerbils Shoplifted from Pet Store (UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: Sometimes you just say ‘fuck it’ and go for it. Employees at a pet shop were cleaning cages and had left the gerbils enclosure unlocked.
